description: This file contains implementation of the CCalcEngine class, including methods for setting radix and number width, toggling bits, calculating logarithms, and managing numeric base conversions and display updates within a calculator engine.

classes.name: CCalcEngine
classes.description: Main class responsible for calculator engine operations, including base and width settings, bit toggling, and display management.

methods.name: SetRadixTypeAndNumWidth
methods.description: Sets the radix (number base) and number width, updating internal state and triggering display refresh.

methods.name: TryToggleBit
methods.description: Toggles a specific bit in the rational number representation, returning true if the toggle was successful.

methods.name: QuickLog2
methods.description: Calculates the nearest power of two less than or equal to the given number.

methods.name: UpdateMaxIntDigits
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of digits needed for current settings, adjusting for radix and mode.

methods.name: ChangeBaseConstants
methods.description: Updates internal constants based on the specified radix, maximum integer digits, and precision.

methods.name: BaseOrPrecisionChanged
methods.description: Handles updates when base or precision settings change, recalculating maximum digits and constants.
